Entry.en-US: A completely flat, all-lush square of land — no water, hills, mountains, rivers, or forests. A deliberately boring sandbox.

A mirror duel on a temperate volcanic coast: a drowned river estuary (ria) carves up the centre, a northern range sheds rivers down ridge-and-valley spurs, a volcanic island sits as a sea-locked prize, and a chain of contested cities runs up the central valley — a highland city watching the gorge, a rich pair flanking the spine, and the island below. Latitude sets the climate — Mediterranean, temperate, or northern tundra. Capitals on opposite shores.
